rows.question: Why can the same 30-day fill cost more at a standard pharmacy than a preferred one on this plan?
rows.answer: For this plan and period, the matched 30-day metformin 500 mg supply is $8 at preferred retail and $27 at standard retail under the recorded conditions. On this MAPD pharmacy benefit, preferred retail and standard retail are different cost-share categories for the same days-supply when the network classification on the date of service differs. Preferred retail applies a lower member amount, while standard retail applies a higher member amount. The difference is the category that applied at that pharmacy on that date, not a change to the written prescription.

rows.answer: Enrolling in CenterWell mail service does not alter today’s retail pickup, and retail remains an option. Enrollment does not itself place a fill or start automatic refills. Your existing atorvastatin 20 mg tablet prescription is authorized for 90 tablets over 90 days. Eligible existing prescriptions can use a 90-day supply, and medications may be selected individually.
